1. (Original) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP.

2. (Original) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded __underneath the bottom of the test tube__, oriented for reading downwards.

4. (Original) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer __and wherein the MTP is affixed rather than embedded in the test tube material itself__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of __the test tube__.
